_meta.notes: TYPED form on the older blank (its interim label reads 'April 5', not the 2014 blank's 'April 7'). The type-of-report selection is a typed 'X' beside April 5 rather than a tick in the checkbox; neither amendment box is marked. Signature date handwritten 4/4/14, Summary Page header 'Nelson / 04/04/2014', clerk-stamped APR 04 2014. Line 3 is typed '$0' with no cents - recorded verbatim. Column A arithmetic checks out (0 + 5,808.62 = 5,808.62; minus 3,844.12 = 1,964.50). NOTE: an amendment to this filing exists (key 94ce5fe8) whose Schedule A/B totals are $5,870.62 and $3,906.12, i.e. this April report was later revised upward by $62.00 in contributions and $62.00 in expenditures.

contributions.detail: exact (5808.62 = $5,808.62); the p4 attachment prints its own 'Total Contributions $5,808.62' and the p3 form prints TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED $5,808.62

expenditures.detail: exact (3844.12 = $3,844.12); the p6 attachment prints 'Total Expenditures $3,844.12' and the p5 form prints TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE $3,844.12

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 Schedule A form page: SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell is EMPTY (no rows on the form page) and only the TOTAL line is filled with $5,808.62 - so there is no page-subtotal to gate there, the gate is the attachment total. p4 attachment: 27 transcribed rows sum to 5,808.62 = printed 'Total Contributions $5,808.62' (gates exactly). p5 Schedule B form page: same shape, SUBTOTAL empty, TOTAL $3,844.12. p6 attachment: 20 transcribed rows sum to 3,844.12 = printed 'Total Expenditures $3,844.12' (gates exactly). Balance chain on p2 also closes: line 3 $0 + line 4 $5,808.62 = line 5 $5,808.62; line 5 - line 6 $3,844.12 = line 7 $1,964.50.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 and p6 are LANDSCAPE typed spreadsheet attachments; both re-rendered at 300 dpi and read as three/two horizontal band crops (~700-850 px tall, full width) rather than as whole pages, because a whole rotated page downsamples the ~20-27 row lines below reading size. NOTE the rotation sign DIFFERS BETWEEN THE TWO PAGES OF THE SAME PDF: p4 reads correctly at 90 CCW, p6 at 90 CW (p6 was first rendered CCW and came out upside down, which also made the purpose column appear offset by one row - re-rendered CW to resolve).
itemized.notes: Both schedule FORM pages (p3, p4->form p3 and p5) carry only the words 'See Attached' in the first row and the grand TOTAL; all detail is on the two typed landscape attachments. The attachment column set is richer than the form's: Schedule A has Date Received | First Name | Last Name | Complete Mailing Address | Occupation/Employer | Amount | In Kind/Loan, and Schedule B has Date Expended | Recipient Name | Purpose | Amount | In Kind?. donor_raw is emitted as the printed 'First Name' and 'Last Name' cells joined (kept in printed order, first then last). PRIVACY: the entire Schedule A address column is a solid black COUNTY REDACTION block across all rows, so no city/state exists to record - blank + 'redacted', not a filer omission. Three rows are aggregate/unnamed ('Aggregate' / 'Contribution Under $50'), which is the filer's own label for sub-$50 lumping, not a name we could read. The in-kind items pair across the two schedules (e.g. Schedule A 3/14/14 Steve Beck $820.76 In Kind <-> Schedule B 3/14/14 Salt Lake County Clerk 'Filing Fee' $820.76 In Kind), which is the normal in-kind double entry; both printed totals include them. Cover checks INTERIM / April 5, signed 4/4/14, clerk RECEIVED stamp APR 04 2014 - consistent with the listing label.
